scripts.deploy: bun run db:init:remote && bun --bun wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:manual: bun run build && bun run deploy
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build

DB.description: D1 database for gallery settings, password verifiers, photo records and login throttling. One database serves all galleries in this installation.

PHOTOS.description: Private R2 bucket for unchanged originals and browser-generated JPEG previews. Keep public access disabled.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Shared administrator password for all galleries, at least 12 characters. Choose a strong random value. Changing it invalidates administrator sessions and guest sessions issued for gallery passwords.
